content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR {{THYROID}} IS BEGGING YOU FOR
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Cod | Seaweed | Shrimp | Dairy Milk
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Cashews | Beef Liver | Sesame Seeds | Shiitake Mushrooms
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple | Brown Rice | Hazelnuts
**Selenium** (Cell Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Eggs | Sunflower Seeds
**Potassium** (Fluid Balancer) — Sweet Potato | Coconut Water | White Beans | Bananas
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Oysters | Pumpkin Seeds | Chickpeas | Lamb
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Your thyroid can't make its hormones without iodine — without it, metabolism slows down and energy crashes, which is why seafood and dairy matter more than people think. Copper works quietly behind the scenes too: it helps your body actually use the iron you eat to form red blood cells, so a copper gap can mimic an iron problem. And selenium acts almost like armor for your cells, helping neutralize everyday oxidative stress before it builds up. Everyone's needs are a little different, so listen to what your body's telling you.
